statement: For every class-A activation in the dossier and every b, eta with E log|1-(eta/b)chi-square_b|<0, scalar nonlinear SGD has a unique geometrically ergodic stationary law with equal strictly positive power-law tail constants and exact linear root index; alpha<2 on a nonempty interval above 2b/(b+2).
scope_note: Literature-based application of ABB 2023, not a new renewal theorem or a claim of first-in-literature novelty. Stable-step repair is explicit; literal unrestricted root statement has a nonlinear counterexample in section 5.

statement: ABB arXiv:2102.02299v2 Theorem 2.1 plus Proposition 8.1 supplies exact two-sided tail limits and strict positivity from unbounded stationary support under its continuous asymptotically linear signed-map hypotheses, closing the source gap in the dossier.
locator: arXiv:2102.02299v2 PDF pages 6-7 and 36; equations 12-16 and Proposition 8.1; Ann. Appl. Probab. 33 (2023) 161-199, doi:10.1214/22-AAP1812
